title: SoulNotes
description: Create notes for other players to read. Like the notes in Elden Ring
body:
# SoulNotes Create and Read other players notes. ### ⭐ Features - Create notes for other players - Read the notes - Configure everything - Like Notes ### 🔗 Commands **/note \**: Create a note with the specifyed text at your location
**/deletenote all**: Delete all created notes
**/deletenote all \**: Delete all notes of a player
**/deletenote \**: Delete a note with the specifyed id
**/likenote \**: Like a note with the specifyed id ### ℹ️ Requirements - **Server**: Spigot, Bukkit, Paper, Purpur,... - **Version:**: 1.20+ - **Java-Version:** 17
